description: RE-RANKER: AI scores a caller-supplied list of candidate templates and picks the N best-fitting ones for a given theme or topic. This tool does NOT read stored templates server-side — the caller must supply the candidates explicitly (e.g. call template_list first, then pass the results here). Synchronous — no polling needed. Pass the templates array from template_list (full detail) as candidates. Returns { templateIds } — an ordered array of the winning template IDs.

templates.description: Candidate templates to evaluate. Use template_list with detail='full' and pass the relevant fields.

theme.description: The topic or theme the agent should optimise for (e.g. 'AI productivity tips').

name: template_pick
